scripts.build:frontends: pnpm run build:storefront && pnpm run build:admin
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml eslint.config.js playwright.config.js storefront admin-web tests/e2e .github/workflows
scripts.format:write: prettier --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml eslint.config.js playwright.config.js storefront admin-web tests/e2e .github/workflows
scripts.test:components: vitest run --config storefront/vitest.config.js && vitest run --config admin-web/vitest.config.js
